key_insight: Video-Coder turns video generation into a coding task: an AI agent writes and executes code to build a dynamic 3D scene. This draft video supplies explicit structure and motion signals to guide video generation.
problem_solved: High visual quality does not guarantee precise spatial layouts, coherent motion, or controllable scene composition. Video-Coder addresses these remaining challenges in video generation.
method: Train a code-driven agent to autonomously write and execute scene-building code.
Construct a dynamic 3D scene rendered as a draft video.
Use the draft video's structure and motion signals to guide generation; further training and generation details are not provided in the supplied abstract.
impact: Code-built scenes offer practitioners a way to specify layout and motion more explicitly, potentially improving control over generated videos. The supplied abstract does not include quantitative results.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: AI agent → scene code → dynamic 3D draft → guided video generation.

paper_title: Video-Coder: Reinforcing Agentic Coding for Video Generation
paper_authors: Chaoyang Wang, Sicheng Gao, Junan Hu, Kunyang Li, Dongyang Chen
